body: Chief on the strands candidate 80af255: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS — every strand is atomization-invariant (13 strands probed at 1 vs 5 atoms per role, order-invariant, fragmentation/integration correct, targetMass consumed nowhere, 2-arg bridge unreachable from outside); independent run interview 39/39 JVM+JS, fixtures 96/96, compileAll. REQUIRED before landing: (1) the approved grain said Coverage.of on EVERY rate — only phenomenology has it; participantUnits (:403) feeds nothing else and the :398 Scaladoc claim is false (participantUnits=2 with 8 assessed units still returns Observed density). Add per-rate Coverage now: unit rates Coverage.of(participantUnits, assessedUnits); target-only strands eligible = target units (or situations); anchoring/perceptual/mental become ScoreEstimate + Coverage (Missing on empty, not 0.0) — bead 9's ProfileStrand will wrap these, so the coverage semantics must exist here first; (2) ONE documented unit-membership rule shared by purity/semanticization/otherEventDrift/redundancy — unitHas fires on any mass > 0 while target membership uses ≥ 0.5, so {Target .9, Other .05, GK .05} yields purity 0.5 and semanticization 1.0; use the ≥ 0.5 (or mode) rule everywhere and state it in each field's Scaladoc; (3) anchoring must not count TemporalFact relations (a 'before' relation is not a time anchor) — restrict to Anchor/AtLocation/Movement situations; (4) grainKeys must not mix SituationId and RecallUnitId in one String key space — typed Either key. Nits: Coverage.unsafe at :180; README grain table (mental is unit-grain; perceptual is situation-else-unit). Repost SHA + 3-platform interview evidence; m1 owner-reviews; I land.
